description: This file contains utility functions for managing artifacts, paths, testing workflows, and git worktrees within a software project. It provides mechanisms to check if paths are documentation or test files, handle dependencies, interact with GitHub and local git repositories, and manage worktrees and branches.

methods.name: require_artifact
methods.description: Checks if the specified file exists and is non-empty, else prints an error message and exits.

methods.name: path_is_docsish
methods.description: Determines if a given path corresponds to documentation or documentation-like files based on extension or directory.

methods.name: path_is_testish
methods.description: Checks if a given path appears to be a test file or directory based on naming conventions.

methods.name: path_is_maintainer_workflow_only
methods.description: Identifies paths related to maintainer workflows, such as specific scripts or agent directories.

methods.name: file_list_is_docsish_only
methods.description: Checks whether all files listed are documentation-like files.

methods.name: changelog_required_for_changed_files
methods.description: Determines if a changelog is required based on the list of changed files, excluding documentation, tests, and maintainer-only files.

methods.name: print_review_stdout_summary
methods.description: Outputs a summary of code review findings, including recommendations and findings count.

methods.name: print_relevant_log_excerpt
methods.description: Displays the last 120 lines of a log file, focusing on error or failure markers if present.

methods.name: print_unrelated_gate_failure_guidance
methods.description: Provides guidance for unrelated build or check failures based on specific labels.

methods.name: run_quiet_logged
methods.description: Runs a command while logging stdout/stderr, reports success or failure, and optionally displays relevant logs.

methods.name: bootstrap_deps_if_needed
methods.description: Installs project dependencies if they are not already installed.

methods.name: wait_for_pr_head_sha
methods.description: Waits until a PR's head sha matches an expected sha, with retries.

methods.name: is_author_email_merge_error
methods.description: Detects merge error messages related to author email issues.

methods.name: merge_author_email_candidates
methods.description: Provides a list of candidate emails for merge author identity based on GitHub and local git config.

methods.name: common_repo_root
methods.description: Determines the root directory of the git repository.

methods.name: worktree_path_for_branch
methods.description: Finds the filesystem path for a specific git worktree of a branch.

methods.name: worktree_is_registered
methods.description: Checks if a directory is a registered git worktree.

methods.name: resolve_existing_dir_path
methods.description: Resolves the absolute path of an existing directory.

methods.name: is_repo_pr_worktree_dir
methods.description: Determines if a directory is a PR-related worktree directory.

methods.name: remove_worktree_if_present
methods.description: Removes a worktree if it exists, with safety checks.

methods.name: delete_local_branch_if_safe
methods.description: Deletes a local git branch if it is safe to do so (not checked out in a worktree).
